# Study patients

## Disposition of subjects

```{r}
#| label: disposition

tlf_disposition(adsl) |>
  tbl_nordvale(
    title = "Table 14.1.1: Subject disposition",
    subtitle = "Randomised population",
    source_note = "Percentages use the number of randomised subjects in each treatment group as denominator."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: disposition-numbers

discontinued <- sum(adsl[["COMPFL"]] == "N")
deaths <- sum(!is.na(adsl[["DTHFL"]]) & adsl[["DTHFL"]] == "Y")
```

`r discontinued` subjects discontinued the study before the end of the treatment period, and `r deaths` deaths were reported.
Discontinuation was more frequent in the xanomeline groups than in the placebo group, driven mainly by adverse events at the application site.

## Protocol deviations

Protocol deviations were reviewed before database lock and classified as important or not important.
No deviation was considered to affect the interpretation of the primary endpoint.
